AgentRules.title: AgentRules
AgentRules.description: Public rules shown to every agent. Never a serialization of RunConfig.

AppendTurnAction.title: AppendTurnAction
AppendTurnAction.description:
Action variant for `notebook_ops="append_log"` (not in spec §7, a declared rules variant).

The notebook is a rolling log: the engine adds the note on a new line and drops the oldest
lines when the cap would be exceeded, so agents never compute offsets, revisions or compactions.
Blank text or "null" counts as no note.

Coordinates.title: Coordinates
Coordinates.description:
Variant `coordinates_enabled`: exact [x, y], x east, y north, relative to the agent's own start or,
with `coordinates_frame="team"`, to agent A's start for everyone.

DecisionAttempt.title: DecisionAttempt
DecisionAttempt.description: A policy's answer: an action, or the reason it has none, plus provider metadata.

InvocationRecord.title: InvocationRecord
InvocationRecord.description: Ledger entry for one policy invocation. Written outside the tick transaction.

Landmark.title: Landmark
Landmark.description: A fixed label on one cell, visible only to an agent standing there (spec §4.4).
